title: _Benedicat vos omnipotens Deus, Pater et Filius_
html_source: (Latin) May almighty God bless you, Father and Son.[3] In the Latin Tridentine Mass, which was still in use in 1904, the Dismissal ends with the Blessing, Benedicat vos omnipotens Deus, Pater et Filius et Spiritus Sanctus (May almighty God bless you, Father and Son and Holy Spirit), to which the congregation replies Amen. There then follows the Last Gospel.
